title: Low Front Ground Clearance
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly mention low front-end ground clearance, though several sampled fragments are too vague to confirm the exact issue.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the front end sitting too low, causing curb contact or requiring the car to be lifted when entering driveways.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews use vague references to minor issues without enough detail to confirm whether they concern ground clearance.

limitations: Several sampled fragments are too vague to verify the specific problem, so the topic includes some insufficiently grounded examples.
One negative fragment mentions only unspecified minor issues, which weakens confidence that every example is specifically about ground clearance.
The sample is small and sentiment-stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G70 reviews.
